verdict.rationale: Fireworks AI is an inference and training platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. Tool calling, the Nexus CLI for coding tools, llms.txt and the OpenAPI specs are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not an official MCP server for connecting agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
